title: Kelleran Beq
description: Known as "The Sabered Hand," Kelleran Beq was a Jedi Knight based at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. On the night of the great Jedi Purge, he fought against the clone troopers brought by Anakin Skywalker to execute the Jedi and saved young Grogu from their attack. He escaped with Grogu aboard a Naboo cruiser and found a way to keep him safe.
